changelog:
Initial release of the epub skill.

- Enables extraction, parsing, and modification of .epub ebook files.
- Uses robust unzip-then-parse workflow for reliable processing.
- Supports reading chapters, table of contents, metadata, text, and images.
- Allows conversion, inspection, and editing of epub content.
- Handles both EPUB2 and EPUB3 file structures.
